app.name: AdDesk
app.description: Submit Instagram posts and track Meta ad requests.

auth.loginHelp: Use the email and password your agency created for you.
auth.forgotHelp: If this email has an account, we will send a reset link.
auth.resetSent: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on the way.
auth.changeHelp: Choose a new password before you continue. It must be at least 12 characters.
auth.disabled: This account is disabled. Ask your agency to turn it back on.
auth.noProfile: This login exists, but its AdDesk profile was not created. Ask your agency to repair the account.
auth.invalid: That email or password is not right.
auth.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.notConfigured: AdDesk is not connected to its database yet.
auth.noWorkspace: This login is not attached to a client workspace yet.

setup.title: Connect Supabase
setup.body: Add NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY to .env.local, then restart the app. The service role key stays on the server.

blockerClient.waiting_on_creator_approval: Waiting for the creator to approve

turn.creator: Waiting for the creator to approve

empty.clientRequests: No requests for this client yet.

request.createdBanner: Request {number} is in. We will reply by {time}.
request.next: We check the post, the permission to advertise, and the offer. You will see each status change here.
request.shareCheck: Share link. Staff need to confirm which post this is.
request.resultsLater: Spend and results will appear here after the ad goes live.
request.changeHelp: This request is already being checked. Describe what should change and we will record it in the history.
request.changeSent: Your change request is in the history.
request.internalLater: Internal notes arrive in the next update and stay separate from what the client sees.

form.title: Nominate a post
form.productHint: Optional. You can continue without a product.
form.productName: Enter a product name of at least 2 characters, or leave it blank and continue.
form.noBrand: This workspace has no Instagram account yet. Ask your agency to add one.
form.duplicate: This post is already on {number}. You can still continue.
form.invalidLink: Use a public https://www.instagram.com post, reel, or share link.
form.titleRequired: Enter a request title of at least 2 characters.
form.copyLast: Copy details from the last request
form.referenceHelp: Paste a Google Drive, YouTube, or Instagram link. File upload arrives in the next update.
form.urgentLeft: {left} of {limit} urgent requests left this month.
form.urgentNone: No urgent requests left this month.
form.rights: I confirm that this business has the right to advertise this post, including the visuals, caption, and music, and that the account is a public professional account. AdDesk will never ask for an Instagram, Facebook, or Meta password.
form.dateOrder: The end date must be on or after the start date.

admin.handleHelp: Username or the profile link, for example instagram.com/name.
admin.tempPasswordHelp: Leave this blank to generate one. It is shown once and is not saved.
admin.passwordOnce: Copy this password now. It will not be shown again.
admin.installHelp: Send this link. It does not contain the password.
admin.existingUser: That email already has a login. They were added to this client and their password was left as it is.
admin.passwordWarning: Never ask for an Instagram, Facebook, or Meta password. Access is granted inside Meta Business Settings.
admin.storageLater: File uploads are counted here in the next update. Reference links do not use storage.
admin.closeConfirm: Closing a client stops new requests. The history stays available.
admin.auditHint: Create, update, disable, and password reset actions are recorded here. Passwords are never written to this log.

org.paused: This workspace is paused. You can still view requests. New requests are closed until it is resumed.
org.offboarded: This workspace is closed. You can still view the history.

install.title: Install AdDesk
install.lead: One app for the agency and for clients. Your login decides which panel opens.
install.installed: AdDesk is already installed on this device.
install.androidHelp: If the button is missing, open the browser menu and choose Install app or Add to Home screen.
install.ios: On iPhone and iPad, install from Safari.
install.iosSteps: Tap Share, then Add to Home Screen, then Add.
install.inApp: This page is inside WhatsApp or Instagram. Open it in Chrome or Safari before installing.
install.desktop: Install from the browser menu in Chrome or Edge, or use the button when it appears.
install.prompt: Install AdDesk on this phone so you can open it from the home screen.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: AdDesk needs a connection to load your requests. Nothing was submitted while you were offline.

pwa.pushDenied: Chrome blocked alerts. Allow notifications for this site, then try again.
pwa.pushUnsupported: This browser cannot show Chrome alerts.
pwa.pushMissingKey: Chrome alerts are not configured on the server.
pwa.pushFailed: Chrome alerts could not be turned on.
pwa.pushUnavailable: Open AdDesk in Google Chrome, then turn alerts on there.

errors.invalid_status: That status change is not allowed.
errors.urgent_limit: This client has no urgent requests left this month.
errors.org_not_active: This client cannot submit requests right now.
errors.rights_required: Confirm the rights to the post before submitting.
errors.not_editable: This request can no longer be edited directly.
errors.invalid_instagram_url: One of the links is not a valid Instagram URL.
errors.invalid_brand: Choose an Instagram account from this client.
errors.invalid_product: That product is not on this client.
errors.invalid_reference_url: Reference links must be https links from Drive, YouTube, or Instagram.
errors.last_super_admin: At least one active super admin is required.
errors.already_member: That person is already on this client.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait and try again.
errors.not_configured: The server is missing its Supabase configuration.
errors.invalid_links: Add at least one Instagram link.
errors.assignee_not_agency: Assign the request to someone on your team.
errors.invalid_handle: Use an Instagram username or a profile link, such as instagram.com/name.
errors.invalid_phone: Enter a phone number with 8 to 15 digits.
errors.invalid_slug: The workspace slug can use lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens.
errors.invalid_prefix: The request prefix needs 2 to 6 letters or numbers.
